modules.description: Original practice for station and passenger-service work, including platform safety, information during service changes, and station and train cleaning. Workers follow assigned duties, area boundaries, and the operator's safety instructions.

lessons.caution: Do not enter the track or a restricted area to retrieve an object without following the required procedure and obtaining permission.

checks.explanation: Report from a safe position so staff can control the risk according to procedure.
options: Keep a safe distance and inform the responsible staff member
Run onto the track to retrieve the item
Move the barrier without authorization
Ignore it as long as the train has not arrived
checks.prompt: What should you do when you see a hazard near the platform edge?

checks.explanation: Authorized staff must handle items in hazardous areas; workers must not put themselves or others at risk.
options: Enter the route to retrieve it
Throw it into the staff room
Keep a safe distance, report the location, and follow procedure
Ask another passenger to retrieve it
checks.prompt: A bag has been left near the warning line. What is the correct action?

checks.explanation: Workflow taught: Observe passengers and the platform from a safe position → Give confirmed guidance → Report risks or unusual conditions → Follow instructions from the staff member in charge.
options: Observe passengers and the platform from a safe position
Give confirmed guidance
Report risks or unusual conditions
Follow the instructions of the staff member in charge
checks.prompt: In the “Platform observation and passenger guidance” workflow, what is the next step after the first step is complete?

dialogue.japanese: 三番線はどこですか。
dialogue.meaning: Where is platform three?

dialogue.japanese: この階段を上がってください。
dialogue.meaning: Please go up these stairs.
dialogue.reading: このかいだんをあがってください。

objectives: Menjaga jarak aman dan memperhatikan keadaan peron selama bertugas.
Memberikan arah sederhana tanpa menghalangi arus penumpang.
Segera melaporkan benda atau keadaan yang berisiko.
lessons.response: Do not approach the hazard to retrieve the bag. Notify authorized staff, indicate its location, and follow safety procedures.
lessons.scenario: A bag has been left near the warning line on the platform.

sections.body: Station staff help passengers find platforms, exits, and facilities. Areas near platform edges and train doors require particular attention. Body position, use of walkways, and communication must follow operator procedures. Stay alert while protecting yourself, and do not enter restricted areas without authorization.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: Answer with brief, confirmed directions, such as a platform name or the direction of a staircase. Report unattended belongings, a fallen passenger, or a crowd approaching a dangerous area to the staff member in charge. Do not chase an object onto the track or try to stop a train outside procedure. Example: a bag is left near the warning line. Response: keep your distance, notify staff, and follow local safety procedures.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Amati penumpang dan keadaan peron dari posisi aman
Berikan arahan yang sudah dipastikan
Laporkan risiko atau keadaan tidak biasa
Ikuti instruksi petugas penanggung jawab
lessons.title: Platform Observation and Passenger Directions

lessons.caution: Do not present a personal estimate as the official schedule.

checks.explanation: Unconfirmed information must be identified as such and updated after it is verified.
options: Say the information is being checked and refer to an official notice
Guess the time based on the previous day's schedule
Ask the passenger to wait in any lane
Confirm that the train will arrive shortly
checks.prompt: What is the correct way to proceed when the next train time has not been confirmed?

checks.explanation: Giving truthful information and directing the person to an official channel prevents misinformation and incorrect movement.
options: Give your own estimated time
Say there is no problem and leave
Explain that it is still being checked and direct them to an official source
Direct passengers to another platform without checking
checks.prompt: A passenger asks for the train time after a disruption, but no new schedule is available. What is the correct response?

checks.explanation: Workflow taught: Listen to official announcements or messages → Check available routes, platforms, and times → Report unclear information → Communicate confirmed updates.
options: Listen to official announcements or messages
Check the available routes, platforms, and times
Report information that is unclear
Communicate confirmed updates
checks.prompt: In the “Information during a delay or service change” workflow, what is the next step after the first step is complete?

dialogue.japanese: 次の電車は何時ですか。
dialogue.meaning: What time is the next train?
dialogue.reading: つぎのでんしゃはなんじですか。

dialogue.japanese: 今、確認しています。分かり次第お知らせします。
dialogue.meaning: We are checking. We will let you know when the information is available.
dialogue.reading: いま、かくにんしています。わかりしだいおしらせします。

objectives: Menyampaikan informasi layanan yang telah dikonfirmasi.
Melaporkan pertanyaan yang tidak dapat dijawab kepada petugas operasi.
Menjaga penumpang tetap berada di area yang aman.
lessons.response: Explain that the time is still being checked, point to the official information source, and provide an update after staff confirm it.
lessons.scenario: A service disruption has been announced, but the departure time of the next train has not been provided.

sections.body: Delays, track changes, and diversions can confuse passengers. Staff make announcements using the operator's official information. Use simple wording: the service name, the correct platform or direction, and where to ask if information is not yet available. Do not estimate departure times or direct passengers to another track without confirmation.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: If you receive unconfirmed information, say that it is being checked and promptly contact a supervisor or information center. When directing a group, point out the walking route and avoid making people rush. Example: after a disruption announcement that gives no time, a passenger asks when the next train will leave. Response: explain that the time is not confirmed and direct them to the operator's information source.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Dengarkan pengumuman atau pesan resmi
Periksa rute, peron, dan waktu yang tersedia
Laporkan informasi yang belum jelas
Sampaikan pembaruan yang sudah dikonfirmasi
lessons.title: Information During Delays or Service Changes

lessons.caution: Do not mix liquids, leave tools in passenger walkways, or touch unidentified substances.

checks.explanation: Well-arranged equipment and clear signs keep the work area separate from public routes.
options: So passengers do not trip or enter an area that is not yet safe
So workers can leave the tools when taking a break
So the area looks busy
So the cleaning agent is used up quickly
checks.prompt: Why must cleaning tools and warning signs be arranged properly in public areas?

checks.explanation: Unknown liquid must be handled according to procedure to prevent workers or passengers from being exposed or slipping.
options: Touch it to identify the liquid
Mix it with the strongest material
Do not touch it; report it and secure the area according to procedure
Direct passengers to walk past it
checks.prompt: There is unidentified liquid on a busy floor. What is the correct action?

checks.explanation: Workflow taught: Confirm the assigned area and cleaning task → Prepare tools and signs as instructed → Clean while keeping public routes safe → Report hazardous items or damaged facilities.
options: Confirm the assigned area and cleaning task
Prepare the tools and signs according to instructions
Clean while keeping public routes safe
Report hazardous items or damaged facilities
checks.prompt: In the “Station-area and train cleanliness inspection” workflow, what is the next step after the first step is complete?

dialogue.japanese: 床がぬれています。
dialogue.meaning: The floor is wet.
dialogue.reading: ゆかがぬれています。

dialogue.japanese: 道具を置き、責任者に連絡します。
dialogue.meaning: I will put down the tool and contact the person in charge.
dialogue.reading: どうぐをおき、せきにんしゃにれんらくします。

objectives: Menyiapkan alat dan bahan kebersihan sesuai area yang ditugaskan.
Mencegah alat atau cairan mengganggu pergerakan penumpang.
Melaporkan kerusakan atau kontaminasi yang membutuhkan petugas lain.
lessons.response: Do not touch or mix the substance. Notify the person in charge, follow area-restriction procedures, and use a cleaning product only after it has been identified.
lessons.scenario: During cleaning, an unidentified liquid is found on the floor of a busy concourse.

sections.body: Cleaning duties may cover train interiors and exteriors, platforms, concourses, and station facilities as assigned. Distinguish areas being cleaned from those still in use by passengers. Use tools, supplies, gloves, warning signs, and methods according to facility instructions; do not mix different substances or use them based on a guess.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: Keep tools out of walkways and clear of obstructions. Follow procedure for warning signs on wet floors. Do not touch sharp objects, unidentified liquids, damaged facilities, or damage near the railway; restrict access from a safe position and report it. Example: the concourse floor is wet during a busy period. Response: use the prescribed signs, maintain a safe passage, and request help if the area cannot be secured.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Pastikan area dan tugas pembersihan yang ditetapkan
Siapkan alat serta tanda sesuai instruksi
Bersihkan sambil menjaga jalur pengguna tetap aman
Laporkan benda berbahaya atau fasilitas rusak
lessons.title: Cleaning Checks in Stations and Trains

modules.title: Stations, Passengers, and Cleanliness

modules.description: Original practice in railway movement communication and control. Route changes, signals, operating equipment, and traffic control are handled only by authorized staff with the procedures and qualifications set by the operator.

lessons.caution: Do not operate points, signals, or track equipment unless assigned and authorized.

checks.explanation: Only authorized staff may handle operating equipment because it affects travel safety.
options: Staff assigned and qualified or authorized under the operator's rules
Anyone who can see the equipment
A passenger who offers assistance
A worker from another section without instructions
checks.prompt: Who may operate track or signaling equipment?

checks.explanation: A discrepancy between a signal and an instruction must not be resolved by guessing; hold the operation and report it.
options: Choose whichever indicator looks easier
Change the switch to test it
Hold the action and request confirmation from operations staff
Ask the passenger to choose a route
checks.prompt: The instruction and switch indicator differ. What should be done?

checks.explanation: Workflow taught: Receive instructions from an authorized source → Repeat or verify them according to procedure → Check indicators that are part of the task → Act or hold as directed by the confirmation.
options: Receive instructions from an authorized source
Repeat or verify the instruction according to procedure
Check the indicators that are part of the task
Act or hold as directed by the confirmation
checks.prompt: In the “Route changes and operating equipment” workflow, what is the next step after the first step is complete?

dialogue.japanese: 指示と表示が違います。
dialogue.meaning: The instruction and indicator do not match.
dialogue.reading: しじとひょうじがちがいます。

dialogue.japanese: 操作を止めて、確認してください。
dialogue.meaning: Stop operation and confirm first.
dialogue.reading: そうさをとめて、かくにんしてください。

objectives: Memahami bahwa pengaturan jalur dan isyarat mempunyai urutan resmi.
Menggunakan komunikasi ulang untuk memastikan instruksi operasi.
Menghentikan tindakan dan meminta bantuan saat informasi tidak jelas.
lessons.response: Do not move the equipment. Report the discrepancy from a safe position and ask authorized staff to confirm the instruction and equipment status.
lessons.scenario: A verbal instruction specifies one track, but the equipment indicator shows another.

sections.body: In railway operations, tracks, points, signals, and related equipment determine movement. Misunderstanding an instruction can have serious consequences, so only assigned and qualified workers handle operating equipment. Other workers keep clear and report what they observe. Company rules, official signals, and instructions from operations staff are authoritative.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: Before taking an action within your authority, confirm the track identity, the intent of the instruction, and any communication required by the operator. Repeat the instruction if procedure requires it. If an indicator does not match or a message is unclear, do not guess; hold and report. Example: an indicator light conflicts with a verbal instruction. Response: stop in a safe place and ask the controller to confirm.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Terima instruksi dari sumber yang berwenang
Ulangi atau cocokkan instruksi sesuai prosedur
Periksa indikator yang menjadi bagian tugas
Lakukan atau tahan tindakan sesuai konfirmasi
lessons.title: Track Changes and Operating Equipment

lessons.caution: Do not guess the meaning of a signal or continue moving when communication is interrupted.

checks.explanation: Movement must follow clear communication; if a signal is lost, stop and report it.
options: Stop movement according to procedure and restore communication
Continue using your own estimate
Ask the passenger to give a signal
Walk toward the vehicle to inspect it
checks.prompt: What should you do when the shunting signal is not visible?

checks.explanation: Stopping the activity prevents misunderstanding and exposure to the operating area.
options: Continue at low speed
Give a new signal without coordinating
Stop movement from a safe position and contact the supervisor
Stand between vehicles
checks.prompt: The signaler is no longer visible. What is the correct response?

checks.explanation: Workflow taught: Confirm assigned roles and signals → Ensure safe working positions and a controlled route → Begin communication or movement as instructed → Stop and report if a signal is lost.
options: Confirm the assigned roles and signals
Confirm work positions are safe and the route is controlled
Begin communication or movement as instructed
Stop and report if the signal is lost
checks.prompt: In the “Signals and safety during shunting” workflow, what is the next step after the first step is complete?

dialogue.japanese: 合図が見えません。
dialogue.meaning: I cannot see the signal.
dialogue.reading: あいずがみえません。

dialogue.japanese: 停止して、もう一度確認します。
dialogue.meaning: Let's stop and check once more.
dialogue.reading: ていしして、もういちどかくにんします。

objectives: Mengenali pentingnya isyarat yang jelas saat pemindahan kendaraan di area kerja.
Menjaga posisi aman dan komunikasi dengan anggota tim.
Melaporkan instruksi yang tidak terlihat atau tidak dipahami.
lessons.response: Stop movement according to procedure, remain in a safe position, and ask the supervisor to reestablish communication before resuming.
lessons.scenario: During shunting, a team member can no longer see the signaler.

sections.body: Moving or shunting vehicles may involve a signaler, driver, and supervisor. Each operator has official codes, standing positions, and communication methods. Workers must know their duties before movement begins. If a signal is lost, obscured, or differs from the agreed signal, stop movement according to procedure and report it.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: Do not stand between vehicles or enter their path of movement. Use communication devices and signals only as trained. Check the work route and personnel against the checklist. Example: the signaler is not visible when a move is about to start. Response: do not signal or move; wait until communication is clear again and the supervisor confirms.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Konfirmasi peran dan isyarat yang ditetapkan
Pastikan posisi kerja aman dan jalur terkendali
Mulai komunikasi/pergerakan sesuai instruksi
Hentikan dan laporkan bila isyarat hilang
lessons.title: Signals and Safety During Shunting

lessons.caution: Do not report a suspected cause as fact or promise a restoration time.

checks.explanation: Observed details help send the right assistance and prevent confusion.
options: The location, equipment or service, observed symptoms, and assistance needed
A personal guess about who is at fault
Only the word “broken,” without a location
A promised completion time
checks.prompt: What is an important element in a disruption report to the operations center?

checks.explanation: Report the issue and follow instructions; technical work must not be done by unassigned staff.
options: Dismantle the gate without authorization
Allow the queue to form near a narrow area
Report the location and symptoms and guide passengers as instructed
Promise a repair time
checks.prompt: A ticket gate is broken and a queue is forming. What is the correct step?

checks.explanation: Workflow taught: Observe the location and disruption → Communicate the service identity, location, and symptoms → Wait for a decision or technical assistance → Record and hand over any open status.
options: Observe the location and disruption
Communicate the service identity, location, and symptoms
Wait for a decision or technical assistance
Record and hand over any open status
checks.prompt: In the “Trip report and disruption coordination” workflow, what is the next step after the first step is complete?

Mengikuti perubahan layanan hanya setelah dikonfirmasi.
Meneruskan status yang belum selesai pada pergantian tugas.
lessons.response: Do not dismantle the equipment. Contact operations staff with the location and symptoms, keep passenger routes safe, and give directions based on confirmed instructions.
lessons.scenario: The ticket gate is not responding and a queue is beginning to build.

sections.body: Controllers and field staff must use the correct station name, train service number, or track. During a disruption, prompt and accurate information helps the operator manage service, passenger safety, and technical assistance. Record observable facts, the time, actions taken, and any status awaiting a decision.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: Keep work communications concise: identify yourself, your location, the service or equipment involved, what you observed, and the help needed. Do not attempt repairs or announce a new route unless assigned. Example: a station ticket gate does not respond and a queue forms. Response: keep passengers in a safe place, notify operations staff, and give directions based on confirmed instructions.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Amati lokasi dan gangguan
Sampaikan identitas layanan, lokasi, dan gejala
Tunggu keputusan atau bantuan teknis

modules.description: Original practice in track and railway electrical-facility maintenance. Work includes inspections, maintenance, and reporting; access and technical work are governed by the operator's safety system and supervision by authorized personnel.

lessons.caution: Do not enter an active track or repair a component without protection and a work permit.

checks.explanation: The location and facts help the supervisor assess the risk and decide what to check next.
options: The location and visible condition, then report them to the supervisor
A guessed cause
The name of the nearest person
No record is needed unless it is completely broken
checks.prompt: What should be recorded when an unusual track condition is found?

checks.explanation: Workers who have not been assigned the task must not perform repairs or tests that could create a hazard.
options: Fix it with your foot
Take it home
Do not touch it; report the location to the supervisor
Wait for the train to test it
checks.prompt: A track component appears to have shifted. What is the correct action?

checks.explanation: Workflow taught: Receive the area boundaries and team instructions → Observe the route from an authorized position → Record the location and visible condition → Report findings and wait for directions.
options: Receive the area boundaries and team instructions
Observe the route from an authorized position
Record the location and visible condition
Report the finding and wait for instructions
checks.prompt: In the “Route inspection and recording findings” workflow, what is the next step after the first step is complete?

dialogue.japanese: この部品の位置が違います。
dialogue.meaning: This component is in a different position.
dialogue.reading: このぶひんのいちがちがいます。

dialogue.japanese: 場所を記録して、責任者に報告してください。
dialogue.meaning: Record its location and report it to the person in charge.
dialogue.reading: ばしょをきろくして、せきにんしゃにほうこくしてください。

objectives: Mengamati kondisi jalur sesuai area dan daftar tugas.
Menyampaikan perubahan atau kerusakan dengan lokasi yang dapat dikenali.
Menjaga diri di luar area bahaya sampai ada pengaturan kerja.
lessons.response: Do not pull or tap the component. Record its location, notify the supervisor promptly, and follow instructions about restricting the area or further inspection.
lessons.scenario: During an inspection, a track component appears to have shifted from its usual position.

sections.body: Track work includes measuring track condition, replacing components, handling ballast, and inspecting safety equipment. Inspections are performed by teams familiar with site boundaries, protection schedules, and the tools used. New workers must not enter a track or use work tools without direction and supervision under operator procedures.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: Record the location, type of finding, and time, and take photos or use codes only when company rules allow. Do not touch rails, fasteners, or cables to test them. If a finding appears urgent, notify the supervisor promptly from a safe position. Example: a loose component is found on an inspection route. Response: stop in a safe area, mark the location only as permitted, and report to the supervisor.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Terima batas area dan instruksi tim
Amati jalur dari posisi yang diizinkan
Catat lokasi serta kondisi yang terlihat
Laporkan temuan dan tunggu arahan
lessons.title: Track Inspection and Recording Findings

lessons.caution: Do not assume a cable or device is safe because it appears switched off or motionless.

checks.explanation: A safe status must be confirmed through procedure and authorized personnel, not appearance alone.
options: The equipment may still be hazardous or under system control
All cables contain only water
Equipment is always safe if it makes no sound
So no report is made
checks.prompt: Why must workers not touch equipment that appears to be switched off?

checks.explanation: Do not operate safety equipment; report the issue so authorized staff can secure the situation.
options: Lift the barrier yourself
Turn off the alarm using the nearest box
Keep clear, report the symptoms, and follow safety measures
Ask the driver to proceed through
checks.prompt: The level-crossing alarm keeps sounding, but the gate does not move. What is the best response?

checks.explanation: Workflow taught: Identify signs of trouble from a safe position → Do not touch or operate the equipment → Report the location and symptoms to authorized staff → Wait for the area to be secured and for further instructions.
options: Identify signs of trouble from a safe position
Do not touch or operate the equipment
Report the location and symptoms to authorized staff

Melaporkan alarm atau kerusakan tanpa menyentuh perangkat.
Mengikuti pembatasan area dan arahan pengawas.
lessons.response: Stay in a safe place, do not touch the barrier or equipment, and report the situation to operations staff so safeguards can be put in place.
lessons.scenario: A level-crossing barrier is not moving as usual while the alarm continues to sound.

sections.body: Railway electrical facilities include cables, substations, electrical equipment, signals, communications, and level-crossing safety devices. Some equipment remains dangerous even when it appears inactive. Workers must follow the site's authorization, energy-isolation, and inspection methods; this lesson does not grant permission or provide technical instructions for working on equipment.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: If you see a broken cable, dark signal, alarm, sparks, or damaged crossing barrier, do not approach or operate the equipment. Keep your distance from a safe position and report the location and symptoms to the designated person in charge. Example: a crossing alarm sounds continuously and the barrier appears stationary. Response: do not try to lift it; report the problem promptly and follow safety instructions.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Kenali tanda gangguan dari posisi aman
Jangan menyentuh atau mengoperasikan alat
Laporkan lokasi dan gejala kepada petugas berwenang
Tunggu pengamanan dan arahan lanjutan

checks.explanation: Returning the area to service requires coordination and inspection under the operator's rules.
options: After the final inspection and authorization from the person in charge, as required by procedure
When a worker feels the job is complete
When the main equipment has already been used
As soon as the schedule shows the end time
checks.prompt: When may the work area be returned to service?

checks.explanation: A tool left behind can create a hazard; its status must be resolved and handed over before the area is reopened.
options: Leave the area because everyone has gone home

Ask the next train to inspect it

options: Listen to the briefing and confirm roles

Count the tools and hand over their status before closeout

sections.body: Track or electrical maintenance is carried out by a team under the operator's protection system. Before work, members must know the supervisor, safe locations, access limits, communication equipment, and stop procedure. Returning an area to service also requires the designated inspection and authorization. A worker must not assume the job is complete just because their own task is finished.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: Attend the pre-work briefing and repeat any instruction you do not understand. If communication is lost, boundaries change, or someone is in the wrong area, stop according to procedure and notify the supervisor. At the end, hand over tools, leftover materials, and finding status; do not remove barriers or authorize reopening the track. Example: a tool remains when the team is preparing to close the job. Response: report it and check again as a team before the person in charge declares the area ready.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Dengarkan pengarahan dan pastikan peran
Periksa komunikasi serta batas kerja
Lakukan tugas hanya sesuai arahan

modules.description: Original practice in rail-vehicle inspection, parts management, vehicle production, and station and train cleaning. Technical inspection, assembly, and equipment operation require specific training and supervision.

lessons.caution: Do not press, open, or adjust components outside your assigned duties.

checks.explanation: Checkable details help technicians locate the source of a problem safely.
options: The vehicle number, part, time, and observed symptoms
A guessed cause
The passenger's opinion only
A sign that the work is complete

Ignore it if the door is still moving
Record the symptoms and ask technical staff to inspect it

checks.explanation: Workflow taught: Read the checklist and vehicle number → Inspect the relevant parts according to the task and procedure → Record symptoms and results actually observed → Report them and wait for a readiness decision.
options: Read the checklist and vehicle number
Inspect the relevant parts according to the task and procedure
Record symptoms and results actually observed
Report it and wait for a readiness decision

dialogue.meaning: The door is making an unusual sound.
dialogue.reading: とびらからへんなおとがします。

dialogue.japanese: 車両番号を伝えて、検査をお願いします。
dialogue.meaning: Give the vehicle number and request an inspection.
dialogue.reading: しゃりょうばんごうをつたえて、けんさをおねがいします。

objectives: Mengikuti daftar inspeksi kendaraan dan tidak melewati butir yang belum pasti.
Mencatat gejala sebagai fakta, bukan langsung menyimpulkan penyebab.
Menyerahkan temuan kepada petugas teknis atau pengawas.
lessons.response: Record the vehicle and symptom, do not adjust it yourself, and ask technical staff to inspect it before use.
lessons.scenario: During an inspection, a vehicle door makes a sound that is different from usual.

sections.body: Vehicle work may include scheduled or unscheduled checks of brakes, doors, electrical devices, air conditioning, wheels, and other parts. Company procedures specify who inspects, which tools are used, and how vehicle readiness is decided. New workers must learn the limits of their authority and must not alter components without instruction.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: Record the vehicle or part number, conditions seen or heard, inspection time, and actions taken. If something differs from the checklist, hold the relevant item and report it. Example: an unusual sound is heard while testing a door. Response: do not continue using the vehicle without confirmation from authorized staff.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Baca daftar dan nomor kendaraan
Periksa bagian sesuai tugas serta prosedur
Catat gejala dan hasil yang benar-benar dilihat
Laporkan dan tunggu keputusan kesiapan
lessons.title: Vehicle Inspection and Symptom Reports

lessons.caution: Do not use materials or continue assembly when their identification differs from the work order.

checks.explanation: Numbers and records link the material used to the work order and the vehicle being built.
options: So the correct part is installed and the production result can be traced
So inventory can be mixed
So the label can be thrown away
So the work is completed without inspection
checks.prompt: Why is the component number checked against the work order before assembly?

checks.explanation: The material must not enter assembly until a supervisor confirms that its number and batch match.
options: Install it because its shape is similar
Swap it with other stock without telling anyone
Hold it, record the discrepancy, and request confirmation
Throw away the work list
checks.prompt: A component box on the production line does not match the work order. What is the correct action?

checks.explanation: Workflow taught: Read the work order and component number → Check the material batch, quantity, and condition → Perform the assigned assembly task → Record inspection results and report discrepancies.
options: Read the work order and component number
Check the material batch, quantity, and condition
Perform the assigned assembly task
Record the inspection results and report discrepancies
checks.prompt: In the “Component receiving, assembly, and traceability” workflow, what is the next step after the first step is complete?

dialogue.japanese: 組立てる前に、部品番号を確認します。
dialogue.meaning: Before assembly, I check the part number.
dialogue.reading: くみたてるまえに、ぶひんばんごうをかくにんします。

dialogue.japanese: 番号が作業表と違います。
dialogue.meaning: The number differs from the work sheet.
dialogue.reading: ばんごうがさぎょうひょうとちがいます。

dialogue.japanese: 使わずに、担当者へ確認します。
dialogue.meaning: I will not use it; I will confirm with staff.
dialogue.reading: つかわずに、たんとうしゃへかくにんします。

objectives: Mencocokkan nomor dan kelompok bahan dengan instruksi kerja produksi.
Mengikuti penugasan perakitan serta melaporkan bahan yang rusak atau tidak cocok.
Mencatat hasil kerja agar bahan dan kendaraan yang dibuat dapat ditelusuri.
lessons.response: Stop the affected assembly stage, set the box aside according to procedure, record the numbers on the box and work order, and ask the supervisor to confirm they match.
lessons.scenario: A parts box on the production line has a label number that differs from the work order.

sections.body: Rail workshops and factories receive materials, install or assemble parts, and inspect work against production orders. Each part may have a specific number, material batch, drawing, and installation position. Parts that look alike are not necessarily interchangeable. Use tools and materials, assemble, and inspect only as assigned and under company training and supervision. Records of materials used and inspection results keep vehicle histories traceable.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: Before starting, match part numbers and material batches to the work order. Follow the supplied drawing or sequence, use only tools assigned to you, and record inspections actually performed. If a number does not match, material is damaged, or an assembly differs from instructions, stop that stage and tell the supervisor. Example: a box label gives a different model from the work list. Response: keep it off the assembly line, report the discrepancy, and wait for confirmation.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Baca perintah kerja dan nomor komponen
Cocokkan kelompok bahan, jumlah, dan kondisi
Lakukan tugas perakitan yang ditugaskan
Catat hasil pemeriksaan dan laporkan selisih
lessons.title: Parts Receipt, Assembly, and Traceability

lessons.caution: Do not treat cleaning as technical approval to operate a vehicle.

checks.explanation: The handover records cleanliness and condition; authorized personnel make the technical readiness decision.
options: Tools are returned, the area is safe, and damage or pending tasks are recorded
That the vehicle is definitely ready to operate
That warning signs can be left anywhere
That all components have been repaired
checks.prompt: What needs to be confirmed when handing over cleaning work?

checks.explanation: A damage report must be passed on even when cleaning is complete; do not declare the vehicle ready without an inspection.
options: Close the report because cleaning is complete
Repair it without authorization
Record the damage location and report it before handing over the area
Remove the seat while the train is moving
checks.prompt: The cabin is clean, but one seat is damaged. What is the correct step?

checks.explanation: Workflow taught: Check completed and pending work → Return tools and materials to their places → Record damage or areas that are not yet safe → Hand the status over to the next person in charge.
options: Check completed and pending work
Return the tools and materials to their places
Record damage or areas that are not yet safe
Hand the status over to the next person in charge
checks.prompt: In the “Work completion, cleanliness, and handover” workflow, what is the next step after the first step is complete?

dialogue.japanese: 車内の清掃が終わりました。
dialogue.meaning: The train interior has been cleaned.
dialogue.reading: しゃないのせいそうがおわりました。

dialogue.japanese: 座席が壊れています。確認をお願いします。
dialogue.meaning: The seat is damaged. Please inspect it.
dialogue.reading: ざせきがこわれています。かくにんをおねがいします。

objectives: Menyelesaikan pembersihan sesuai area, urutan, dan perlindungan yang ditetapkan.
Memastikan alat, bahan, serta barang tertinggal ditangani sebelum serah terima.
Meneruskan status pekerjaan yang belum selesai dengan catatan yang jelas.
lessons.response: Do not close the finding just because the cabin is clean. Record the vehicle and seat location, notify the person in charge, and let authorized staff perform the readiness inspection.
lessons.scenario: The cabin has been cleaned, but one seat appears damaged.

sections.body: Station and train cleaning covers public areas and workspaces as assigned. After cleaning or inspection, workers return tools and record unfinished areas. In workshops and factories, materials, components, and test items must remain separate from passenger routes. Cleanliness does not mean that a vehicle or facility has passed its technical inspection.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: Perform the final checklist: return tools, deal with wet-floor signs, clear the area of lost property, and report damage. Do not remove barriers until the area has been declared safe. Example: cabin cleaning is complete but a seat is damaged. Response: record the vehicle number and seat location, notify the person in charge, and mark it according to procedure before the vehicle is returned.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Periksa pekerjaan yang selesai dan tertunda
Kembalikan alat dan bahan ke tempatnya
Catat kerusakan atau area yang belum aman
Serahkan status kepada penanggung jawab berikutnya
